verdict.rationale: GrowthBook's own docs describe scheduling feature rules and ramp schedules or release plans that automatically ramp a rule up over time. This is time-based automation, but only of flag rollouts, and nothing documents recurring jobs or general workflows on a cron-like schedule. Missing for 10: recurring/cron-style job scheduling, general-purpose workflow scheduling beyond flag rule ramps, detailed docs on schedule configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.
